references.role: Main centered original base character only as identity/style reference; neighboring fragments and preview background ignored.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent 4x4 full-body animation sprite atlas for Crown & Kingdoms, hand-painted medieval isometric RTS. Reference image is identity/style ONLY: copy the main centered soldier, ignore all neighboring fragments, background and preview shadows. 1536x1024 landscape, strict four columns four rows, sixteen separate complete connected figures. Same person, weapon proportions and clothing throughout; same fixed 3/4 isometric camera facing right, warm upper-left daylight, realistic painted textures, blue team cloth suitable for recolouring. Actual transparent background, no labels, grid or terrain. Keep complete helmet, face, weapon, both hands and boots inside EVERY source cell, with generous transparent margins. Figure body about 190 pixels tall, readable at 46 gameplay pixels. Frames0-7 (top two rows): eight sequential distinct walking poses with visibly alternating leading feet, knee bends and heel lifts, natural weight transfer, weapon carried in two hands. Frames8-15 (bottom two rows): weapon action sequence, frame8 relaxed ready pose suitable for idle, frames9-11 shoulder/aim/prepare, frame12 FIRE/RELEASE instant, frames13-15 recovery/loading, then loop to ready. Keep hands physically attached and correct anatomy, one coherent weapon per frame. NO detached smoke, flying bolts, bullets or other projectiles. Tiny transparent foot shadow only. No pixel art, flat icons, extra limbs, modern equipment or cropped weapons. Character: original Chu Ko Nu soldier from reference, East Asian man with short moustache, dark conical metal helmet with small top knob, dark brown lamellar/leather armour and red collar, blue sleeves and blue split skirt panels, dark leggings and brown boots. Weapon is one compact wooden REPEATING CROSSBOW with a visible rectangular top magazine, forward bow limbs and simple working top lever. During walking carry the repeating crossbow horizontally across torso. Action: raise and shoulder it, aim, operate/recover the lever and release at frame12, lower to reset/load then ready. Keep the same box-magazine repeating crossbow clearly identifiable throughout, no extra bow or firearm, no shield, no sword.
